architecture_contract.accuracy_exclusion_explanation: Accuracy UI projects canonical lifecycle exclusion reason counts from the existing authoritative blocker fields; excluded rows are never silently reset or included.
architecture_contract.action_column: Report and chart actions are icon-only in a narrow far-right column with accessible labels.
architecture_contract.active_training_readiness: operator command coordinates official data, issuer assets, exact-gap coverage, settlement, shadow training, governance and forward-progress evidence while production influence remains zero
architecture_contract.ai_stock_intelligence: Grounded human-readable current state, drivers, key levels, action and invalidation are generated only from the frozen evidence packet and cannot create authority.
architecture_contract.analysis_coverage_separation: Immutable universe cursor coverage, analysis terminality and analysis completion are separate authorities; coverage_complete can never imply analysis_complete.
architecture_contract.analysis_worker_recovery: bounded generation-aware analysis pools recover one fully stale generation without unbounded thread creation
architecture_contract.archive_validator_bytecode_isolation: The clean-extraction validator disables interpreter bytecode writes before importing packaged integrity helpers, so its pre-execution inventory proof cannot create an unmanifested __pycache__ file when called without an inherited PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE environment.
architecture_contract.artifact_installability: Installer accepts only artifact_type=INSTALLATION_CANDIDATE or PRODUCTION_RELEASE with installable=true. An INSTALLATION_CANDIDATE must be SOURCE_SEALED, production_ready=false, purpose=EXACT_WINDOWS_TARGET_PROOF, broker authority NONE, and remains pending installed/end-to-end proof; checkpoints/WIP cannot execute installation.
architecture_contract.autonomic_recovery_verification: Recovery success requires a persisted business-state delta after the action; controller metadata, stage labels, retry timestamps and recovery counters are not proof of progress.
architecture_contract.blank_scanner_fail_closed: During market hours, API health, UI shell rendering, warming state, or zero-scanned scanner output can never satisfy production acceptance.
architecture_contract.blocking_worker_heartbeat_truth: Long synchronous official-data, Research, forward-evidence and OCC work emits heartbeat-only liveness without changing useful-progress authority.
architecture_contract.bounded_maturity_governance_work: Heavy governance and walk-forward synchronization executes in bounded maturity-worker batches and cannot monopolize settlement/forward-evidence lifecycle ownership.
architecture_contract.bounded_operator_read_paths: Performance, Research retention, Level-5, MTF and Stock Intelligence foreground HTTP serve materialized/local snapshots and queue bounded background refresh; heavyweight evidence computation is forbidden on browser requests.
architecture_contract.browser_chart_containment: Chart and indicator canvases are paint/layout-contained within bounded hosts so hidden/resize transitions cannot overflow the Stock Intelligence page.
architecture_contract.camarilla_authority: Camarilla uses the exact previous completed NSE session H/L/C, records its source session, classifies levels relative to current cash price, displays at most one actionable support and resistance, and suppresses overlap with canonical structure.
architecture_contract.candle_projection_authority: Pure CanonicalCandleProjectionService owns completed-period filtering and resampling; Chart/MTF/scanner compatibility cannot call private MarketDataService projection helpers.
architecture_contract.canonical_completion_truth: A waiting or scheduled state can never imply completion. Delivery coverage requires committed attempted population equal to the immutable universe plus an explicit completed sweep; Level 5 requires product maturity level 5 and the exact proof gate to pass together.
architecture_contract.canonical_data_continuity: Exact-gap append persists canonical source bars, derives 3m/5m/15m/30m/1H/4H/1W/1M locally where possible, restores latest completed-session daily continuity from complete intraday evidence for operational display, and never promotes derived EOD rows to research authority.
architecture_contract.canonical_decision_settlement_lifecycle: The PostgreSQL canonical decision is the one lineage from candidate through entry geometry, Model Paper monitoring, exit, classified outcome, costs and net P&L; parallel manual-journal authority is forbidden.
architecture_contract.canonical_evidence_snapshot: one immutable hash-bound identity/coverage/timeframe/mathematics/feature/inference/risk/decision generation per symbol and desk
architecture_contract.canonical_historical_acquisition: one exact-gap service; partial provider rows never promote a whole requested range; every accepted write is physically verified
architecture_contract.canonical_index_alias_resolution: Governed NIFTY/sector aliases resolve from the local canonical index registry without depending on fuzzy catalogue warm-up or provider I/O.
architecture_contract.canonical_level_authority: One completed-candle cash-price structure service with Wilder ATR14, ADX14, +DI and -DI is shared by chart, scanner, Stock Intelligence, trade map, research and backtest; Camarilla is a separate previous-session projection and cannot create canonical S/R.
architecture_contract.canonical_market_context_registry: Aliases are lookup-only. Every visible market/sector row must resolve through the PostgreSQL instrument catalogue to an exact provider instrument key; unresolved rows are suppressed, canonical display names are stable, and price/breadth/direction share one evidence session.
architecture_contract.canonical_market_sector_snapshot: required broad and sector identities are persisted; partial or older polls cannot erase verified rows
architecture_contract.canonical_product_state_envelope: One background-built immutable cache-only Product State Envelope owns scanner, Research, Model Paper, maturity, OCC blocker and source-freshness truth. HTTP /api/product-state performs no provider, database, scanner, Research or OCC refresh work.
architecture_contract.canonical_selector_evidence_replay: Walk-forward replay reads governance PostgreSQL selector populations/predictions/outcomes as primary authority after verified migration; historical SQLite is compatibility-only and cannot silently override canonical evidence.
architecture_contract.canonical_timeframe_authority: one case-sensitive enum/parser; 1m and 1M are structurally distinct across provider, storage, mathematics, API and UI
architecture_contract.capital_mark_to_market_no_leverage: Capital-profile proof requires capital/concurrency/position sizing plus mark-to-market and no-leverage evidence; a realised-return-only curve is insufficient.
architecture_contract.chart_control_truth: Every visible chart control must alter a real chart series/pane sourced from canonical candle/indicator authority; warming materialized projections are boundedly re-read rather than leaving a decorative no-op button.
architecture_contract.chart_geometry: Price, Volume and optional RSI/MACD share identical candle-time authority and synchronized horizontal navigation. 1m is preserved; 3m/5m/15m/30m/1H/4H are NSE-09:15 anchored canonical backend aggregations. Local before-cursor history pages prepend without viewport jump; manual pan disables Follow Live; new bars do not auto-shift unless Follow Live is enabled; IST labels are zoom-density aware; paginated Heikin history fails closed until separately authoritative.
architecture_contract.chart_levels: Chart foreground reads hot runtime plus the last completed canonical candle projection. Canonical cold-store materialization and missing-gap repair are background-owned and never block the browser; first/last candle, row count and storage high-water remain evidence-bound.
architecture_contract.chart_release_boundary_r38: Chart feature work frozen for launch sprint; chart remains optional supporting evidence and cannot override trader trust/admission.
architecture_contract.chart_series_modes: Candle, Heikin Ashi and Line are genuine series modes with persisted selection, preserved interval/range and active-series overlays.
architecture_contract.chart_timeframe_identity: Every chart response carries independently computed served-timestamp spacing evidence bound to the requested canonical interval; frontend rendering fails closed unless the proof passes and matches the selected timeframe.
architecture_contract.chart_two_row_visibility: The chart toolbar has two measurable visible rows. The timeframe/candle-control row cannot collapse to zero height; all 10 canonical timeframe controls must be visible/clickable under browser proof.
architecture_contract.chart_visible_range_authority: The selected symbol and interval transition is evaluated before chart state mutation; first load uses the persisted explicit range, same-series refresh preserves operator zoom, and 1D/5D/1M/3M/1Y/5Y/Max plus Follow Live publish logical range evidence without reloading.
architecture_contract.clean_application_install: Install on a clean machine or over any prior Project Laddu application payload without an installed-version prerequisite. Only runtime/application payload is replaced; existing data, secure state and canonical external data planes are retained and independently proven.
architecture_contract.closed_learning_quarantine: Forward evidence may mark an isolated shadow challenger QUARANTINE_REVIEW_REQUIRED; a human can quarantine the active challenger; production influence and broker authority remain zero throughout.
architecture_contract.closed_market_delivery_research: Verified completed-session close may support Delivery research/screening while execution_price_authority remains false; Model Paper opening still requires a fresh executable quote.
architecture_contract.closed_session_quote_continuity: After market close, Stock Report loads verified completed-session quote and stored candles without requiring a live WebSocket tick; intelligence cannot block quote/history acquisition.
architecture_contract.completed_close_display_continuity: After market close or cold quote cache, Stock Intelligence may display the verified completed daily close with explicit display-only/non-execution authority; canonical selected quote remains the only execution-price authority.
architecture_contract.complexity_contribution_gate: Hybrid/ML must add positive post-cost top-band edge over mathematics on exact matched candidate populations with a positive 95% moving-block-bootstrap lower bound, population consistency and regime robustness.
architecture_contract.controller_live_blocker_reconciliation: Operations projection may demote a stale controller blocker only when the same component has a newer live healthy/expected-idle supervisor state with fresh heartbeat/progress evidence; trading/risk authority is unchanged.
architecture_contract.corporate_action_fail_closed_reconciliat: Only explicit positive factors already present in content-addressed official NSE ingestion may project into the corporate-action authority; ratios are never inferred and full-history coverage is never fabricated.
architecture_contract.critical_quote_side_effect_isolation: Production Model Paper admission remains on the supervised quote side-effect lane; local counterfactual/evidence/quant-paper marks are isolated so research lock contention cannot stall production quote/Model Paper progression.
architecture_contract.cross_plane_reconciliation: bounded catalog-and-tail comparison across canonical, Parquet, QuestDB and runtime planes with explicit repair plan
architecture_contract.cross_sectional_full_sweep_accumulation: Cross-sectional research freshness is tracked per symbol and merged across successive immutable-universe batches; one early TTL slice can no longer suppress later batches.
architecture_contract.cross_surface_truth: Workspace, Performance, Research, System Status and Operations consume the same canonical Product State snapshot identity first. Detail endpoints may enrich but cannot redefine core counts, blocker, maturity or availability.
architecture_contract.data_plane_policy: discover preserved canonical data-plane state independent of installed app release; Prepare without schema mutation; exact immutable migration ledger when present; stop runtime; prove retained authorities; forward schema; replace payload only
architecture_contract.decision_authority_visual_intensity: Visual emphasis scales with authority tier; FINAL_SELECTED is strongest emerald, evidence-ready is green, building/pending amber, rejected red, unavailable neutral.
architecture_contract.decision_proof_independent_evidence: Decision Proof reads independent materialized participation, market/sector and official NSE evidence; no canonical decision is required merely to display upstream evidence truth.
architecture_contract.deep_history_acceptance_budget: Deep-history convergence is limited to one worker with smaller batches during acceptance so historical completion cannot starve customer/runtime PostgreSQL work.
architecture_contract.deep_research_history_utilization: Delivery research receives up to 756 local candles plus 504 delivery sessions; Intraday receives up to 600 local candles. This is retained-data consumption only and never provider history I/O inside scanner workers.
architecture_contract.defect_closure_policy: no defect closes on a patch; architecture, engineering, integration, storage, mathematics, API, browser, restart, fault injection and Windows-target evidence are tracked independently
architecture_contract.delivery_fast_continuation: Incomplete Delivery sweeps self-reschedule every 8s during market hours; if committed coverage age exceeds the bounded threshold and no named blocker exists, a watchdog accelerates the next cheap-coverage attempt. Deep analysis may defer but cannot stop immutable-universe coverage.
architecture_contract.delivery_independent_coverage_lane: A dedicated cache-only Delivery coverage worker owns immutable-universe coverage progress independently of bounded deep analysis; provider I/O and model work cannot pin the coverage cursor.
architecture_contract.delivery_interactive_priority_separation: Selected-stock/Stock Report priority may defer expensive Delivery deep analysis but cannot prevent cheap immutable-universe coverage, eligibility screening, cursor advancement or exact-snapshot checkpoint persistence.
architecture_contract.delivery_population_invariant: Delivery scanner population must equal the immutable Delivery PostgreSQL snapshot; Intraday population or batch size can never replace the Delivery universe denominator.
architecture_contract.derivatives_context: NSE/Upstox futures and options OI, change OI, PCR, IV and liquidity may confirm, weaken or veto cash-stock interpretation for eligible underlyings; they never create canonical levels, enter the active universe or obtain production influence.
architecture_contract.direction_freshness: Market/sector direction recomputes only on a newer authoritative price/breadth timestamp; unavailable or stale inputs collapse/freeze rather than flicker or fabricate Neutral.
architecture_contract.event_driven_control_plane: Progress-aware job registry, bounded event bus, Level-5 blocker graph, allow-listed deterministic recovery, action verification and dependency continuation; risk, ledger, model and database authority remain fail-closed.
architecture_contract.evidence_action_surface: compact two-row evidence quality, post-cost expectancy, risk admission, trade-map and next-action surface with no empty decorative card
architecture_contract.exact_installed_package_binding: Installed acceptance independently binds release identity, attestation, package manifest, backend tree and frontend tree to the exact sealed candidate before live evidence is interpreted.
architecture_contract.exact_selected_stock_identity: Every stock report payload, quote, candle, level, mathematical regime and model attribution must match the selected symbol and instrument key; cross-symbol cache reuse fails closed and clears prior DOM immediately.
architecture_contract.expected_idle_truth: Declared retry/yield waits are expected-idle and cannot be misclassified as STUCK solely because useful-work counters are intentionally unchanged.
architecture_contract.failure_isolation: A failed/stale optional component affects only its own state. Available verified components continue to render independently.
architecture_contract.final_market_proof_both_desks: Production evidence cannot pass unless the live scanner performs quote-ready deep mathematics for both desks and the Intraday deterministic mathematical baseline passes capital-profile selector replay; Delivery must independently pass historical OOF capital WFA.
architecture_contract.foreground_memory_only: Stock Report, chart/history, fundamental/research and chart-overlay readers return only hot or last-completed in-memory truth. Persisted KV, candle-lake, QuestDB and provider reads are producer-only.
architecture_contract.foreground_serving_plane: Interactive HTTP reads completed in-memory/materialized projections only. Cold Parquet/DuckDB/QuestDB/provider access and physical reconciliation are forbidden on the request thread; bounded coalesced background producers may use canonical cold stores and publish the next completed projection.
architecture_contract.foreground_workload_isolation: P0/P1 selected-stock, risk and market-context work pre-empts P3-P5 scanner/history/research activity; reserved interactive PostgreSQL and network capacity cannot be consumed by bulk jobs.
architecture_contract.forward_durability_tiers: Genuine forward evidence is cumulative and never reset or backfilled from historical replay: 126d/300/20/3 initial, 252d/750/40/3 mature annual, 504d/1500/80/4 strong two-year, 756d/2000/120/4 deep-cycle; collection continues beyond all tiers.
architecture_contract.forward_evidence_instrumentation: Forward evidence publishes bounded stage-specific progress counters and heartbeats; null progress tokens during active settlement work are forbidden.
architecture_contract.frontend_identity: one canonical release version binds runtime, DOM, frontend owner, cache-busters and final asset hashes; manifest is generated only after frontend finalization
architecture_contract.governance_first_selector_replay: Purged selector replay reads immutable governance PostgreSQL selector populations/predictions/outcomes first and fails closed when legacy evidence exists without a verified migration checkpoint.
architecture_contract.governance_pool_launch_headroom: Dedicated governance write pool max raised from 4 to 8 while governance_read remains isolated; cumulative psycopg requests_queued is never interpreted as current queue depth.
architecture_contract.governance_read_isolation: Research/UI/WFA diagnostic reads use a dedicated Governance PostgreSQL read pool; publication/settlement writes retain the canonical governance write authority.
architecture_contract.historical_foreground_projection: GET /api/historical is a chart projection read. refresh=false never invokes the legacy synchronous MarketDataService historical composer, provider token checks or exact-gap planner; explicit refresh/backfill requests schedule bounded repair independently.
architecture_contract.historical_oof_capital_lineage: Capital-profile historical ML WFA accepts only fold-local immutable artifacts or row-bound prior-only OOF model SHA256 lineage with horizon-aware purge and decision/outcome timestamps.
architecture_contract.historical_pit_runtime_sweep: Historical PIT/WFA enrichment is an autonomous P5 runtime sweep with checkpoint state, low process priority, mid-run yield/terminate on higher-priority product pressure, and bounded retry; daily scheduling is watchdog/retraining only.
architecture_contract.history_terminal_accounting: Deep-history retries terminate after governed no-progress exhaustion with explicit terminal reason; terminal failure never counts as operational-ready and unknown backlog is reported separately.
architecture_contract.human_decision_surface: Compact active rows separate current LTP, coherent rupee/percent change, lifecycle decision, positive Entry/T1/SL, reassessment status and action; zero is never a missing-value sentinel in presentation.
architecture_contract.index_live_identity: Required NSE/BSE indices use dynamic catalogue resolution with exact static identity fallback so subscriptions cannot disappear when the local resolver is incomplete.
architecture_contract.index_refresh_progress_truth: Successful periodic index-level refresh increments refresh generation and publishes a changing verified cursor; zero-refresh cycles fail closed.
architecture_contract.install_transaction_state_machine: One durable hash-protected journal enforces package proof -> environment proof -> data authority proof -> retention snapshot -> stage -> runtime quiescence -> durable-state proof -> schema -> retention proof -> payload activation -> secure/data preservation -> service start -> backend readiness -> frontend identity -> operational proof -> COMMIT. Any pre-COMMIT failure records deterministic rollback state.
architecture_contract.installed_data_conveyor: Bounded runtime-owned official NSE acquisition retries, tiered critical/enhancement/maturity readiness, content-hash admission and truthful failure projection; GET routes never download.
architecture_contract.installed_gate1_batch_projection: One canonical eligible-equity catalogue read is diversified and projected in memory through query-free authority-row presentation; per-row identity-store lookup, provider I/O and customer provider-key leakage are forbidden.
architecture_contract.installed_longitudinal_self_proof: Read-only installed T0/T+ proof uses cache-only /api/product-state as its core authority with bounded 5-second attempts and writes physically verified ZIP plus SHA-256 only under C:\Temp\ProjectLaddu\Operational-Progress-Proof.
architecture_contract.installed_target_proof: exact-build browser proof rejects any runtime, DOM, owner, cache-buster or asset-hash drift while preserving retained production data
architecture_contract.installed_truth_repair: Browser-visible status must be derived from retained verified quote evidence and exact endpoint authority; transient poll transport failure, missing optional decision mode or late service import cannot overwrite stronger installed truth.
architecture_contract.installed_usefulness_gate: product readiness is blocked without physical persistence telemetry, healthy priority recovery and browser-proven chart/MTF/levels
architecture_contract.installer: single clean-machine/upgrade entrypoint; prerequisite bootstrap before mutation; exact package and transaction parity proof; forward-only data-plane changes; retained authority proof; ProgramData-only transactional working state; payload-only swap; fail-closed rollback; C:\Temp\ProjectLaddu reserved for logs/evidence only
architecture_contract.installer_argument_contract: PowerShell-to-Python transaction arguments contain no empty array members; optional previous-version, detail and fault-injection pairs are omitted unless non-empty, and the real adapter is native-Windows-proven through COMMIT and ABORTED_SAFE.
architecture_contract.installer_module_contract: Explicit PowerShell modules and required commands are proved before target mutation; transaction phase parity is executed during preflight.
architecture_contract.installer_phase_handoff: Every multi-phase installer transition is explicit, checksum-protected, release-bound and transaction-bound; Apply may not depend on process-local state created by Prepare.
architecture_contract.installer_workspace_policy: All executable/staging/rollback/preflight installer working state lives under C:\ProgramData\ProjectLaddu\runtime\installer-transactions; C:\Temp\ProjectLaddu contains evidence/logs only.
architecture_contract.instrument_brand_assets: Upstox identity mapping plus governed open-source issuer-logo catalogue and verified content-addressed local cache; placeholder does not count as completion
architecture_contract.instrument_effective_date_preservation: Routine catalogue refresh never rewrites historical active_from. Existing v119 damage may use CURRENT_INSTRUMENTS_SHADOW_FALLBACK for shadow learning only; survivorship-controlled Level-5 qualification remains false until point-in-time overlap is proven.
architecture_contract.instrument_presentation: Provider instrument keys are machine identity only; customer surfaces resolve canonical symbol and company/index name through the PostgreSQL instrument authority.
architecture_contract.intelligence_evaluation_guard: Executable leakage canaries, within-population null-alpha falsification and paired same-population complexity-contribution proof are mandatory research gates before model complexity can progress.
architecture_contract.interim_asset_cache_identity: Interim frontend asset URLs carry the candidate revision cache key so an in-place upgrade cannot continue executing stale JavaScript/CSS from another v131 interim payload.
architecture_contract.interim_market_test_boundary: R1 is installable only for current market-hours evidence collection; it is NOT ACCEPTED and NOT RELEASE and may not imply Windows/live-market/end-to-end PASS.
architecture_contract.intraday_bounded_local_compute: Delivery remains deterministic Clean-Core analysis. Intraday prepared analysis is pure/local and executes through one bounded worker; per-job timeout/batch budget can release the scan lane while at most one retired generation remains bounded.
architecture_contract.intraday_lane_single_implementation: Automatic, manual and lifecycle Intraday triggers converge on canonical _run_live_mode_scan_impl(intraday) under the single intraday_analysis lane.
architecture_contract.intraday_single_authority: intraday_scanner is recurrent live-analysis cycle authority; intraday_coverage is immutable whole-universe sweep authority; Operations cannot project a duplicate virtual Intraday scanner with coverage counters under the live-analysis component identity.
architecture_contract.level5_acceptance_cycle: Progressive stages distinguish foundation recovery, shadow evidence start, forward evidence accumulation, walk-forward qualification and final Level 5 certification without weakening 0% influence safety.
architecture_contract.level5_continuous_reassessment: every verified Model-Paper mark re-evaluates the frozen thesis as VALID, WEAKENING or INVALIDATED against current canonical quote/trend evidence
architecture_contract.level5_cumulative_settled_evidence_scope: Current immutable cohort owns live operational state; governed cumulative settled forward evidence across eligible cohorts owns training/walk-forward maturity. Qualification thresholds remain unchanged and fail closed.
architecture_contract.level5_evidence_matrix: failure-first hard-gate matrix; average score is navigation only and cannot certify maturity
architecture_contract.level5_governed_learning_loop: settled Model-Paper evidence automatically creates deterministic append-only findings/proposals; material production changes require human approval and production_applied is structurally false
architecture_contract.level5_prior_window_threshold_freeze: Selection threshold candidates are evaluated only on the first purged training window, the chosen threshold is frozen before unseen walk-forward folds, threshold search count is included in multiple-testing penalties, test leakage is forbidden, and inadequate regime robustness fails closed.
architecture_contract.level5_rich_signal_ledger: append-only GENERATED, OPENED, REASSESSED, MANAGED and SETTLED lifecycle events retain age, state, final context and exact authority/model/policy versions
architecture_contract.level5_signal_age: generated_at and opened_at are first-class; generation/open age and decision delay are persisted in lifecycle evidence; age risk policy is versioned and can only de-risk after human approval
architecture_contract.lifecycle_resource_window: One-shot lifecycle/WFA temporarily yields bulk history/research work, runs bounded evidence checks/replay, then always restores bulk work in finally.
architecture_contract.lifecycle_stage_isolation: A research WFA desk execution error is retained as explicit evidence but cannot abort read-model refresh and final reconciliation for the whole lifecycle.
architecture_contract.live_chart_bar: Ordered identity-verified ticks form canonical 1m/3m/5m/15m/30m/60m/240m OHLCV in hot runtime authority. The browser polls a bounded local projection and displays LIVE, STALE, CLOSED or WARMING without aggregating financial data.
architecture_contract.live_index_sector_stream: All governed canonical index/sector identities are admitted to the broad LTPC live subscription plan; Workspace overlays hot verified stream/cache quotes with LTP, point change, percent change and freshness while background heat authority retains breadth/trend enrichment.
architecture_contract.live_market_scanner_operability: Market-hours production acceptance requires both Intraday and Delivery to prove a non-empty canonical population, quote-ready work and at least one deep mathematical analysis cycle. Zero promotions are acceptable only with explicit governed rejection/blocking evidence; blank/warming/no-data scanner shells fail.
architecture_contract.live_progress_proof_refresh: Explicit Progress & Proof Refresh/Copy reads a bounded current in-memory runtime snapshot with its own capture timestamp and cannot silently reuse an old materialized projection.
architecture_contract.live_trader_workspace_refresh: Cache-only Workspace projection polls at 3 seconds; selected symbol is escalated to rich live subscription without full-page reload or cold historical I/O.
architecture_contract.local_mtf_authority: LocalMtfProjectionService reads canonical candle storage only; provider, scanner, controller, Research and application-runtime dependencies are forbidden.
architecture_contract.local_state_preservation: Existing data/ and non-installer-managed secure/ files are hash-captured by the typed manifest authority after runtime quiescence and must remain byte-identical through schema/payload replacement before activation.
architecture_contract.logo_policy: Issuer logo placeholders are removed from the operational prototype. Logo assets remain outside the critical path until broad installed coverage is proven.
architecture_contract.longitudinal_operational_progress: Useful progress is committed business-state movement, never heartbeat/wall-clock churn. Incomplete Delivery sweeps remain active until committed cursor completion and visible progress is reconciled with OCC.
architecture_contract.market_hour_animation: changed-digit odometer animation is permitted only during active NSE market hours; closed/historical values update immediately
architecture_contract.migration_lineage: Published v104 migration ledger remains the immutable database anchor for an existing canonical data plane; clean machines bootstrap the current schema; release lineage remains exact sealed v108 -> v114 -> v115 -> v116 and never uses rejected v109.x through v111, rejected v113 or installed-target v112 as release parents.
architecture_contract.minimal_mtf_sources: All ten customer timeframes remain mandatory; provider/history acquisition has exactly three canonical base families: 1m, 15m and daily. 3m/5m derive from 1m; 30m/1H/4H derive from 15m; 1W/1M derive from daily. Derived customer frames never create duplicate broker-history acquisition authority.
architecture_contract.ml_efficacy_withdrawal: Only VERIFIED matured outcomes may measure RankIC/NDCG model efficacy; failing or unverifiable active-model efficacy withdraws ML ranking influence while preserving the deterministic mathematical score.
architecture_contract.ml_population_qualification: Delivery and Intraday separately expose foundation, immutable population, feature completeness, shadow training, forward-clock eligibility, label maturity, same-population walk-forward and governed influence; final maturity gates never block safe evidence accumulation.
architecture_contract.model_attribution: Stock Intelligence exposes deterministic evidence score, governed ML weight/contribution and the exact blocker when model authority is zero
architecture_contract.model_calibration_drift_authority: Recent-vs-prior matured ranking populations expose RankIC, NDCG, calibration-error and net-expectancy deltas. Calibration deterioration is a governed WATCH signal; no calibration statistic may auto-retune weights or thresholds.
architecture_contract.model_efficacy_closed_learning_loop: Active champion health is checkpointed as append-only MODEL_EFFICACY_DRIFT findings. WATCH/WITHDRAW states create human-required MODEL_AUTHORITY_REVIEW proposals with production_applied=false; protective ML withdrawal remains reversible and mathematical authority is unaffected.
architecture_contract.model_efficacy_regime_authority: Active ML ranking authority is evaluated from VERIFIED matured outcomes both in aggregate and by observed market regime; two independently qualified failing regimes withdraw only ML influence and cannot alter the deterministic mathematical score.
architecture_contract.model_paper_bootstrap_authority: Deterministic bootstrap ranker with zero production influence and broker authority NONE collects initial Model-Paper evidence until a learned shadow ranker is qualified.
architecture_contract.mtf_depth_surface: ten aligned timeframe model boxes with a neutral timeframe row and colour-coded confluence value row; selected-timeframe summary remains one line and depth is on demand
architecture_contract.nonblocking_instrument_readiness: Instrument catalogue liveness is supervisor-owned; universe freeze, symbol-index warm-up and optional fundamentals/auth bootstrap are detached side effects and cannot stall catalogue heartbeats.
architecture_contract.occ_projection_health_separation: OCC projection-worker health advances on projection generation while business stall detection uses separate canonical business signatures.
architecture_contract.official_nse_data_authority: shipped active multi-URL official report plan merged non-destructively into retained configuration; bounded session-aware acquisition, validation, hashing, provenance and PostgreSQL/Parquet ingestion; previous valid authority retained on failed refresh
architecture_contract.one_command_final_market_proof: RUN_LEVEL5_FINAL_MARKET_PROOF.cmd captures package guards, exact installed binding, API/browser customer flow, corporate-action truth, catalogue refresh, historical capital WFA, model governance, live authority snapshots, real forward maturity and installed supporting gates into one evidence ZIP.
architecture_contract.one_shot_lifecycle_closure: One bounded operator action requests both scanners, advances governed Research/Model Paper and settlement, executes Delivery and Intraday historical capital WFA, refreshes projections, and publishes exact blockers without fabricating a Final decision, production model publication, or forward maturity.
architecture_contract.operational_history_convergence: Persistent exact-gap priority queue uses physical stored growth, listing-age-aware operational/research/deep readiness, provider-depth terminal states, bounded retry and selected/open/scanner/research priority; ready instruments receive incremental completed-session maintenance only.
architecture_contract.operational_progress_truth: Scanner, data conveyor, forward evidence, operator read models and priority recovery publish stable business-state progress signatures. Expected idle never resets useful-progress age; incomplete eligible work remains supervised.
architecture_contract.operations_control_centre: One customer-facing System & Operations surface exposes consolidated health, the one material blocker, safe recovery options and current data/scanner availability first; jobs, logs, controller internals, endpoint catalogue and proof remain diagnostic detail.
architecture_contract.operations_log_authority: Operations logs are sourced from bounded redacted installed log tails with explicit source files; undefined transport errors and object stringification are prohibited.
architecture_contract.operations_role: Operations observes independent components and recovery state; it is not a prerequisite for Search, Quote, Chart, MTF, S/R or Stock Report.
architecture_contract.operations_root_cause_first: Operations projects shared dependency cause ahead of symptom workers and exposes recovery verification truth.
architecture_contract.operator_force_fresh_serialisation: Explicit Progress Refresh/Copy waits for any auto-poll to finish (bounded) and then performs its own fresh read; auto-poll concurrency cannot silently reuse stale forward evidence.
architecture_contract.operator_progress_proof_control_center: One first-class browser surface exposes scanner, data, Research/ML/settlement and forward-evidence progress from canonical operations projections, supports only allow-listed bounded actions, shows exact blockers/errors, and provides copyable job/action/evidence payloads without granting broker or risk authority.
architecture_contract.outbox_claim_writer_semantics: integration.claim_outbox is mutating lease acquisition; explicit read_only=false transaction; never implicit retry
architecture_contract.package_inventory: ZIP payload must equal the generated allowlist plus package manifest exactly; unmanifested extras and omitted files are hard failures before executing packaged code.
architecture_contract.package_transient_bytecode_hygiene: Before exact package inventory proof, installer removes only non-authoritative Python __pycache__/pyc/pyo transients from a reused extraction; every other unmanifested file remains fail-closed. Preflight compilation/import redirects or suppresses bytecode writes outside the sealed package tree.
architecture_contract.performance_default_authority: Broker authority NONE means Performance opens on Research / Model Paper evidence by default; Production remains a separate explicit lane and is not applicable until broker authority is separately approved.
architecture_contract.pit_feature_source_timestamp_aliases: Verified scanner quote_as_of/provider_timestamp/quote_timestamp aliases are accepted as immutable source-time evidence; missing source time remains fail-closed and is never synthesized.
architecture_contract.postgres_connectivity_failure_taxonomy: PORT_UNAVAILABLE, DATABASE_UNREACHABLE, AUTHENTICATION_FAILED, DATABASE_NOT_FOUND and MIGRATION_LEDGER_OR_IMMUTABILITY are distinct fail-closed classes; a transport timeout can never be reported as ledger corruption.
architecture_contract.postgres_generation_authority: Stable logical PostgreSQL authorities publish exactly one checked physical pool generation; one persistent supervisor builds a fresh candidate off-path and atomically swaps only after SQL verification, while retired-generation failures are fenced and recovery admission is bounded.
architecture_contract.postgres_transaction_recovery: Transactions are pinned to one physical generation; capacity, statement, lock, serialization and SQL errors cannot trigger database recovery, writes never retry implicitly, and lost COMMIT acknowledgement is an explicit unknown outcome reconciled by durable idempotency or outbox identity.
architecture_contract.preflight_order: Package integrity/installability/sealed source lineage first; discover retained data/secure authority independently of old application version; Prepare emits transaction-bound handoff without schema mutation; retained canonical data planes require immutable migration hashes before runtime stop.
architecture_contract.priority_materialization: LocalProjectionDispatcher uses a bounded 4-worker priority queue: chart=0, technical=10, persistence=30, enrichment=60, background=90; duplicate keys coalesce and queue capacity is bounded.
architecture_contract.priority_pipeline_recovery: leased durable jobs, progress heartbeats, stale-lease recovery, bounded retry and append-only recovery events
architecture_contract.priority_pipeline_serial_leases: Only the next actionable selected-stock stage may own a lease; downstream stages wait without leases until prerequisites exist.
architecture_contract.priority_stock_pipeline: Retired from foreground authority. Any legacy priority-sync path is explicit/background compatibility only and cannot gate Stock Report, chart, MTF or support/resistance.
architecture_contract.prospective_prediction_lineage: Genuine forward selector predictions are a distinct immutable persisted-evidence lane bound to prediction payload SHA, model version, population, candidate and pre-outcome timestamps; they are never described as historical retraining.
architecture_contract.quote_previous_close_authority: live/current-at-close quote plus canonical previous completed-session close from quote, official report or completed daily candle; missing authority is explicit and priority-enriched
architecture_contract.r42_workspace_candidate_first: Workspace prime real estate is the ranked selected-candidate population; desk execution is two linear rows; market/index/sector information is supporting context only.
architecture_contract.r42_workspace_no_descriptive_chrome: Customer Workspace omits MARKET PULSE/SECTOR PULSE explanatory headings and uses compact context rails instead.
architecture_contract.r43_selected_candidate_lifecycle_ledger: Workspace Selected Candidates follows canonical candidate/preparing/active rows and projects stock/name, LTP, ₹/% change, Entry, Target, SL, authoritative hit, next action, outcome status and Net P&L without inventing trading authority.
architecture_contract.r43_workspace_route_isolation: Exactly one top-level customer page is visible; Workspace cannot remain force-displayed beneath Stock Intelligence, Opportunities, Model Paper, Accuracy, Research or Progress.
architecture_contract.r44_compact_market_context: Workspace market/sector support is a single non-scrolling visual decision rail; scanner health is one supporting line. These context projections cannot create or override canonical trade authority.
architecture_contract.r44_final_signal_workspace: Workspace customer surface is Final Signals only: research/prepared rows stay in Opportunities; visible rows require Final/Open/Promoted/Actionable lifecycle plus positive Entry/Target/SL, are ranked by canonical score, and expose one-line lifecycle fields with mode and age/timeline.
architecture_contract.r46_materialized_research_panel: Research catalogue materializes a full-temporal-depth, full-cross-section shadow-training projection in DuckDB with explicit PIT/current-fallback identity authority. It removes repeated joins without introducing a new research-universe cap; production scanner/selector universe is unchanged.
architecture_contract.r46_panel_failure_truth: Training panel failures preserve explicit stage/error authority; historical data cannot be reported empty merely because a query/merge failed.
architecture_contract.r48_evidence_semantics: Actionable runtime failures/blockers and non-failure evidence maturity gaps are projected in separate customer sections; evidence accumulation cannot make an otherwise healthy runtime look failed.
architecture_contract.r48_ui_containment: Progress/error/evidence rows own a bounded minmax(0,1fr) text column; displayed diagnostic payloads are compact previews while Copy retains the complete evidence object. Hidden Stock Intelligence destroys chart compositor instances and suspends chart-only timers until the page is active again.
architecture_contract.read_model_cost_fail_closed: Missing BSE cost-group authority blocks cost projection per row without crashing the read-model/Market Radar projection.
architecture_contract.readability_floor: Dense financial layout is preserved by spacing/compaction rather than sub-10px text; primary tables and status surfaces have an explicit readable typography floor.
architecture_contract.readable_stock_header: Multi-period evidence remains readable at >=10px on desktop. One-line layout uses compact geometry and horizontal overflow where necessary; micro-font shrinking to force fit is forbidden.
architecture_contract.release_claim_policy: source validation never marks target-runtime live data, scanner, Research settlement or Level 5 gates as passed without installed evidence
architecture_contract.release_lineage: Every installable release cryptographically names its exact sealed source parent. Target installation eligibility never depends on the currently installed application version.
architecture_contract.research_activation: Fresh exact-identity scanner/opportunity candidates with direction and defensible Entry/Target/SL maps automatically create immutable Research populations; production influence remains zero.
architecture_contract.research_current_population_reconciliati: Paper, monitoring, settlement, research-ledger and performance stages are joined back to the current immutable population identity so historical backup cannot falsely advance or erase the active lifecycle.
architecture_contract.research_final_population_lineage: prediction/member/population/outcome joins are exact on population_fingerprint plus candidate_id where applicable
architecture_contract.research_http_projection_only: Quant Research, Forward Progress and Forward Clock HTTP handlers serve only the latest supervised in-memory projection and never perform synchronous governance fan-out.
architecture_contract.research_lifecycle_reconciliation: Valid analysed decisions automatically recover or create immutable populations, point-in-time features and same-population Baseline/ML/Hybrid predictions; Model Paper monitoring, settlement, Research ledger and independent Accuracy/Performance expose exact counts and candidate IDs.
architecture_contract.research_model_paper_admission_truth: Every current-population three-arm prediction set with Paper=0 is reconciled to an explicit actionable admission blocker, governed wait, terminal non-selection or pending evaluation; unexplained zero is forbidden.
architecture_contract.research_monitoring: Active Research/Model Paper rows expose stable decision ID, model/horizon, side, entry, target, managed stop/trailing state, last price, MAE/MFE, lifecycle state, P&L and blocker through settlement, ledger and performance. planned_entry/planned_t1/planned_sl are canonical aliases; incomplete or inverted geometry is explicitly NON_ACTIONABLE.
architecture_contract.research_projection_install_gate: HTTP readability is not readiness. The final installer gate waits for the cache-only /api/quant-research-plane projection to satisfy explicit top-level ok=true and state=READY, uses StrictMode-safe property metadata for optional JSON fields, never assumes a blockers property exists, and persists the successful projection into installer evidence.
architecture_contract.research_readability: Retained Research is a permanent versioned read model. Existing verified snapshot remains visible with as_of/freshness while local asynchronous refresh proceeds; no install or page load may wipe historical evidence.
architecture_contract.research_retention_reconciliation: Installer proves physical PostgreSQL, QuestDB and immutable Parquet authority high-waters directly before/after schema and activation; post-activation Research preservation manifests remain projection evidence, never the sole retention authority.
architecture_contract.research_settlement: research and Model Paper candidates retain frozen entry, target, stop, trailing/secure-profit controls and horizon; eligible outcomes reconcile to Signal Ledger and separate Research Accuracy/Performance
architecture_contract.research_signal_metric_eligibility: Open Model Paper signals are excluded from settled accuracy and realized performance. Only scorable target/stop/trailing/secure-profit/session/horizon settlements enter wins, losses, win rate, post-cost INR expectancy and MAE/MFE evidence; Research-only candidates remain excluded until governed admission and settlement.
architecture_contract.retained_history_scanner_scheduling: Already-retained canonical daily history is asynchronously summarized into a zero-authority scheduling prior before the 12/32-name deep-analysis gate; missing history cannot exclude a symbol and cannot alter trade confidence.
architecture_contract.retained_snapshot_bulk_hydration: One priority technical bulk hydration loads retained v3/v2/v1 snapshots by prefix; cold symbol requests wait for that bounded pass before computing only genuinely missing symbols.
architecture_contract.runtime_isolation: Each release owns immutable versioned backend and Research Python environments. Clean application replacement never pip-mutates an existing runtime; pointers change only inside the payload transaction and restore on rollback.
architecture_contract.safe_recovery_priority: Concrete recoverable FAILED/DEAD/STUCK/NO_PROGRESS safe components outrank broad coverage goals; accepted asynchronous actions remain pending until a later useful-progress signature verifies them.
architecture_contract.safe_recovery_semantics: Recover-all evaluates actual actionable SAFE_COMPONENT states before invoking recovery. No eligible component is a verified bounded no-op rather than an HTTP conflict.
architecture_contract.safe_scanner_recovery: Intraday and Delivery recovery both reconcile the authoritative desk checkpoint and request/coalesce a governed scan through the bounded repair dispatcher; unsupported generation rotation is forbidden.
architecture_contract.scanner_commit_truth: Delivery visible sweep progress advances only after successful cycle completion and persisted checkpoint; prepared analysis context can never alias numeric counters.
architecture_contract.scanner_directional_candidates: Shortlisted members expose preliminary LONG/SHORT/DIRECTION_PENDING, setup, score and exact blocker; watch candidates are not labelled entries until entry/target/stop geometry is authorised.
architecture_contract.scanner_execution: Scanner is a consumer of prepared local/materialized data. Deterministic bounded local compute is isolated from provider/history I/O; scanner failure cannot affect Stock Report.
architecture_contract.scanner_layout: Scanner Progress is a full-width row immediately below Index and sector direction; Intraday and Delivery use two compact horizontal cards with shared terminal rhythm and no narrow-column wrapping.
architecture_contract.scanner_monotonic_sweep_projection: Workspace primary funnel consumes cumulative persisted per-sweep stage counts; delayed batch-local or stale same-sweep projections may not decrease visible progress. Reset requires a new sweep identity.
architecture_contract.scanner_runtime_telemetry: Delivery publishes batch/quote/deep elapsed time, coverage/quote/deep throughput, worker capacity, deferral reason and last-progress time.
architecture_contract.scanner_stage_drilldown: every Delivery and Intraday funnel stage and every workspace operational count is clickable and discloses current rows, state, value, detail and direct navigation
architecture_contract.scanner_supervisor_progress_truth: delivery higher-priority yield is EXPECTED_IDLE; intraday completed governed cycle is accountable operational progress; no timeout inflation
architecture_contract.scanner_terminal_accounting: Every shortlisted candidate resolves to analysed, mathematically rejected, data-pending, data-blocked or capacity-deferred with exact reason counts; unexplained shortlist-to-analysis loss is forbidden.
architecture_contract.secondary_surface_policy: Workspace and Stock Report are the only intentionally dense trading surfaces. Performance, Research, Settings and System & Operations use customer-polished summary-first layouts with actionable insight and technical evidence progressively disclosed.
architecture_contract.selected_stock_canonical_hot_path: Selected Stock Report analysis may submit only admission-approved decisions through the same canonical save_decision authority; research/watch/reject rows remain outside canonical decisions.
architecture_contract.selected_stock_command_surface: five compact rows: identity/quote/action; canonical+dual-desk decision; price structure/mathematics/model attribution; two-row MTF timeframe/value matrix; chart controls with on-demand depth
architecture_contract.selected_stock_latency_contract: Interactive Stock Report must return boundedly from hot/last-completed projections without broker or cold-store blocking. A cold symbol may return explicit WARMING quickly, but acceptance separately requires background convergence to complete authoritative data before completeness can pass.
architecture_contract.selected_stock_snapshot: Stock Report consumes a symbol/mode-keyed completed snapshot projection with explicit WARMING/stale state. Cold construction is background-owned; cross-symbol reuse remains forbidden.
architecture_contract.semantic_evidence_state_authority: One state vocabulary across Workspace, Stock Intelligence, Opportunities, Model Paper, Accuracy, Research and Progress: healthy/running/qualified/final=green; evidence wait/partial=amber; actual fail/reject=red; unavailable/not-applicable=neutral; live/context=blue/cyan.
architecture_contract.session_aware_reference_collection: Weekend/holiday reference-data cycles resolve the latest eligible exchange report date instead of probing non-trading calendar dates.
architecture_contract.signal_accuracy_authority: Accuracy and performance include only settled canonical decisions with entry, target, stop, exit, classified win/loss and net P&L; open, incomplete, research-only, ambiguous, expired and invalidated records remain visible but excluded.
architecture_contract.signal_geometry: LONG and SHORT entry, target and stop geometry is validated identically in backend and frontend; invalid maps cannot render or promote.
architecture_contract.single_pass_technical_materialization: One bounded local source-frame read is reused for 10-frame MTF, canonical S/R, indicator metrics and price-performance anchors; evidence families/timeframes are not removed for latency.
architecture_contract.source_attestation_recomputed: The shipped deployment validator recomputes source-tree and inventory SHA256 from the exact sealed package; source attestation is not trusted as a static declaration.
architecture_contract.stage_state_machine_ownership: Market-data acquisition, Research admission, Model Paper evaluation, settlement and evidence each own an independent durable state and recovery lane. In-flight work is idempotent, not circuit-breaker failure fuel; every candidate transition terminates in an explicit persisted outcome.
architecture_contract.standard_chart_viewport: Interval constructs canonical candles while range owns visible history. Default unpinned viewport is adaptive by interval; 5m+1D fits one NSE session (~75 bars). User range persists across timeframe changes; pan/zoom/follow-live remain independent.
architecture_contract.stock_intelligence_convergence: Browser treats PARTIAL/WARMING local projections as transient and boundedly re-reads the same exact symbol/instrument until retained chart/technical projections are ready; no provider/cold-store I/O is moved onto HTTP.
architecture_contract.stock_price_performance: Completed daily candles plus the verified current quote own 1W, 2W, 1M, 3M, 6M, 1Y and 5Y returns; the browser only formats the backend projection and exposes anchor lineage.
architecture_contract.stock_report: Fast local-first read model: canonical identity + hot quote + local candles + latest materialized technical/research/decision snapshots. Scanner, controller, provider history, Research recomputation and priority leases are forbidden from the initial render path.
architecture_contract.storage_budget_authority: Docker VHDX is observed against a 20 GB warning / 23 GB critical / 25 GB operational target. Hard quotas and automatic volume pruning are forbidden because PostgreSQL/QuestDB authorities must remain durable.
architecture_contract.synchronous_elevation_handoff: Installer elevation is synchronous and exit-code preserving: the unelevated launcher waits for the elevated child, propagates its result, and cannot report success before installation finishes.
architecture_contract.system_health_projection: GET /api/system-health reads one completed health projection or returns explicit WARMING/last-known truth immediately. Parquet physical_summary, QuestDB checks, PostgreSQL/reference reconciliation and other expensive probes run only in the background health producer.
architecture_contract.system_operations_unification: System and Operations are one customer-facing control plane ordered status -> primary blocker -> safe recovery -> available capabilities -> market-data/scanner state. Background jobs, controller detail, logs, endpoint catalogue and raw proof are expandable diagnostics and cannot dominate the primary surface.
architecture_contract.theme_contract: Trader shell and all chart panes support persistent Light and Dark presentation without changing market-state or decision semantics.
architecture_contract.trade_map_visual_projection: Canonical FINAL or valid planned Research geometry projects entry, target, stop and time-axis metadata into price labels and a risk/reward box. Research remains dashed Model Paper evidence and can never be promoted by the UI.
architecture_contract.trader_trust_authority: Every trading surface projects TRUSTED/DEGRADED/DO_NOT_TRUST from critical runtime blockers, current DB availability/waiters and bounded customer-read p95 latency; DO_NOT_TRUST forces customer NO-TRADE presentation without mutating canonical stored evidence.
architecture_contract.tradingagents_reference_boundary: TauricResearch/TradingAgents concepts may inform future research orchestration (checkpoint/resume, typed outputs, identity/data grounding, analyst/risk separation) but R28 ships no TradingAgents/LangGraph dependency and grants no external/LLM decision authority.
architecture_contract.two_lane_async_architecture: LocalProjectionDispatcher owns deterministic local read-model computation; BackgroundRepairDispatcher owns provider/network/exact-gap repair. The lanes do not share worker capacity.
architecture_contract.typed_local_state_manifest: Python owns path normalization, reparse-point rejection, deterministic enumeration, SHA-256 capture, exclusion policy and before/after comparison through bounded JSON files. PowerShell owns orchestration only and never materializes the preserved file collection.
architecture_contract.ui_internal_state_policy: Workspace and Stock Report may show only user-meaningful market/data states, counts, results and concise blockers. Scheduler/controller/thread/generation/internal component states such as yielding_to_selected_stock are diagnostics-only and must never be humanized into trading-surface text.
architecture_contract.ultra_scalp_intraday_lens: Ultra Scalp is a fail-closed Intraday lens using local live quote/depth/microstructure, backend-formed live OHLCV and market/sector context; live chart readiness requires a forming verified-tick bar, it is never a third desk and remains Automatic Model Paper only with broker authority NONE.
architecture_contract.universal_stock_intelligence: Every governed NSE/BSE cash equity resolves through one canonical security identity and renders available local quote/chart/MTF/levels immediately; cold enrichment is exact-gap, asynchronous and never blanks stronger retained truth.
architecture_contract.visual_language: operator-supplied white readable terminal with one sans family, one numeric mono family, governed five-size scale, compact panels and consistent semantic states across six pages
architecture_contract.walk_forward_evidence_depth: Standard Delivery ML begins from a 504-1008-session initial training history when available and evaluates every remaining eligible chronological OOF fold; bounded first-use mode remains shadow-only.
architecture_contract.wfa_evidence_short_circuit: Capital WFA is not executed when complete selector snapshots/date depth already prove that a valid chronological fold cannot exist; the exact blocker is persisted instead.
architecture_contract.wfa_index_migration_authority: Governance migration 007_r26_wfa_query_indexes.sql is included in the authoritative immutable migration plan and applied idempotently.
architecture_contract.why_explanation_persistence: Opportunity Why explanation is keyed by stable desk/instrument identity and survives live scanner/projection refresh, sorting and count updates until the operator closes it, selects another candidate, or leaves Opportunities.
architecture_contract.win_rate_optimization: maximize Wilson-90 lower-bound decisive win rate only among configurations with positive lower-confidence post-cost net-R, PF>1, minimum sample and positive early/late temporal halves
architecture_contract.windows_postgres_endpoint_authority: PostgreSQL loopback ports are Windows excluded-range/socket-bind proven, effective Docker bindings are inspected after startup, and every DSN is rebuilt from those actual bindings before authenticated connectivity or lineage proof.
architecture_contract.windows_runtime_metadata_publication: Research runtime manifest is verified into installer evidence first; the live service is then quiesced for a bounded exact-hash metadata swap, restarted, and both research API READY and frontend identity are re-proven before OPERATIONAL_PROOF.
architecture_contract.workspace_capital: funnel-style compact capital authority board aligned with desk scanner boards
architecture_contract.workspace_search: content-aligned compact pill search with live status and release identity anchored at the far right
architecture_contract.workspace_status_scope: Single-row operational stages use gray not-run, amber partial/stalled, green complete/fresh and red failed states; every blocked count opens exact members and reasons.
architecture_contract.workspace_transport_resilience: Transient cache-only Workspace fetch failures receive bounded fast retry while exact last-verified state is retained; persistent interruption exposes last-verified age instead of replacing truth with zeros.
architecture_contract.workspace_visual_system: One release-level UI authority loaded last; Opportunities-scale typography, 14px body, >=11px metadata, desk KPIs never horizontally scrambled.
architecture_contract.zero_by_error_forbidden: A failed or slow detail request retains the last-known-good canonical Product State and marks detail/staleness explicitly; UI failures may never synthesize zero, Ready, Unavailable or No Active Blocker over stronger retained truth.
